scientific_integrity: A direct exact finite-population reduction is proved, not a mean-field approximation. Finite numerical checks are corroboration only; proof uses global trigonometric inequalities, a unique minimizer and a nondegenerate fold. This is a self-review, not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Only identical frequencies and exact two unequal initial clusters, with phase lag strictly between zero and quadrature.
No transverse stability or general multicluster theorem.
The one-step no-slip threshold is not claimed as a full bifurcation classification above threshold.
An equivalent specialization of classical sine-circle-map results may exist outside inspected sources.
title: Sharp phase-slip onset and square-root critical window in a two-cluster discrete Kuramoto map
